payload.comment: Profiling stage is clean and internally consistent. PathMNIST (9-class, 3-channel RGB, 28×28) is correctly configured under the standard MedMNIST distribution. Archive integrity verified (MD5 match), split sizes identical to official sizes, no subsampling. Class distribution is well-balanced (imbalance ratio ≈ 1.63) with near-identical train/val proportions, indicating no split-level distribution shift. No blank images, no duplicate train samples. Ambiguity risks among visually similar histology classes at 28×28 resolution are appropriately documented. The test-domain note (CRC-VAL-HE-7K from a different clinical center) is correctly flagged for later OOD interpretation. Worker isolation is not enforced (local_subprocess) and image_digest is null—these are operational notes, not data-integrity defects. Two fields (data_profile.ambiguity_note, anomaly_ingestion.comment) are preview-truncated per compacted_fields; this is expected and does not indicate incomplete artefacts. No deterministic findings. No omitted artefacts. All evidence supports proceeding to the next stage.
observations: Archive integrity verified: MD5 a8b06965200029087d5bd730944a56c1 matches verified hash; SHA256 also recorded.

Worker isolation not enforced (local_subprocess); image_digest null—operational notes only.

No deterministic findings; no omitted artefacts; no LLM issues raised.
